Animal recording credits

The G.L.O.W. wildlife demo plays brief excerpts from these recordings. Excerpts were trimmed, faded, and level adjusted. The raccoon clip joins three short calls from one pack, including one pitch-shifted sample. The edited coyote and owl excerpts retain their respective CC BY-SA licenses.

Coyote

“Pack of coyotes howling” by Rybkovich, recorded in Ventura County, California. Source · CC BY-SA 4.0.

Great horned owl

“Bubo virginianus - Great Horned Owl XC156403” by Bushman, via Xeno-canto and Wikimedia Commons. Source · CC BY-SA 3.0.

Sierran tree frog

“Sierran Treefrog Vocalization” by the U.S. Geological Survey. Source · Public domain.

Raccoon

“Raccoon Chatter” by jnargus, shared and edited by AntumDeluge via OpenGameArt. Source · CC BY 4.0.

These clips illustrate animal calls; the demo does not identify live wildlife.
